metadata.title: Aalo -Til chutney | Potato and sesame salad | Nepali Recipe
metadata.description:
Delicious Nepalese potato salad sprinkled with roasted sesame seed and mixed with fried onion and chilies in mustard oil.

Ingredients:
Boiled Potatoes - 2-3 medium sized
Sesame seeds (roasted & pounded) - 4 tablespoons
Green chilies -  3 or 4 nos
Onion - 1 medium sized
